title: Necessary-to-salvation things are in Scripture — the rest need not be
source_text: II. Quod ad primum attinet, ante omnia nostri Theologi distinguunt inter ea quae sunt ad salutem necessaria, & ea quae ad salutem necessaria non sunt. Et quidem ea quae sunt ad salutem necessaria Scriptura sacra contineri asserunt. Ea vero quae non sunt ad salutem necessaria, ex eorum mente Scriptura contineri nihil necesse est.
pass_a_gloss: As to the first point, before all else our Theologians distinguish between those things which are necessary to salvation, and those things which are not necessary to salvation. And indeed they assert that those things which are necessary to salvation are contained by sacred Scripture. But those things which are not necessary to salvation, according to their mind, need not at all be contained by Scripture.
pass_b_english: First our theologians distinguish what is necessary to salvation from what is not.
They hold that Scripture contains what is necessary to salvation. What is not necessary need not, on their view, be in Scripture at all.

choices.why: Modal claim about what Scripture must contain, not denial that extras exist.
